_about: Final narration: one normal male voice for every line, natural speed in the files; the trailer plays each line at 1.2x with pitch preserved (browser time-stretch). Run: python video/generated/tts.py --lines vo_final.json --voice Iapetus
voice_style: Speak in a normal, natural male voice, like a clear and friendly presenter. Conversational, not dramatic, not announcer-like.

lines.text: In our framework, each dot is a patient. The piles are the waiting. A few take the fast track.
Waiting is a decision nobody made.
